name: claude-hunter
description: Live Claude Code token-usage monitor in the status bar

claudeHunter.binaryPath.description: Absolute path to the claude-hunter core binary. When empty, the extension looks for a bundled binary.

claudeHunter.projectsDir.description: Claude Code projects directory. Empty means ~/.claude/projects.

claudeHunter.ceilingMillions.description: Estimated effective-token ceiling (in millions) for the current plan.
